procedures.title: Load a file with Data import
procedures.before: The masters the file refers to exist, and you know whether the file adds new records, updates existing ones, or both.
steps: Admin › Data import. The Import tab lists every upload you may run under Select process, with All modules first.
Type in the search box (e.g. leave balance) or open a module on the left, then choose the process.
Say what the file is for
Under What is this file for? choose Insert new records, Update existing records or Insert and update. Choose Next: prepare your data.
Monthly attendance asks Attendance month and Blank days; CTC asks Company; Attendance check-ins asks the time zone.
Choose Download sample file. Keep its header row, replace the example rows with yours and save as CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited).
Drop the file on Upload your file and choose Upload and check. The button waits until the upload has finished.
If Match the columns appears, pick the PeopleOS field for each column (* = required) or Ignore column, then Save and check.
Read the tiles To add, To update, Skipped, With errors. Fix errors in your file and choose Re-upload fixes, or run the rest.
Enter a Reason, choose Import N row(s) and confirm. Import finished shows Added, Updated, Skipped and Failed.
Choose Download results to keep each row's outcome, or View import log to open the upload.
procedures.result: The rows are written through the same rules as the screens, as one audited operation, and the upload is listed in Recent uploads.

procedures.title: Load organisation masters at go-live in the right order (Core, Project Management, Integration)
procedures.before: Companies exist (created on their own screen). You hold employee.import, organisation.create and people_setup.create; Tenant Super Admin does.
steps: Regions (zones) that branches belong to, and business regions that group branches.
Levels with their rank; grades with their level code and rank, so levels go first.
Work locations with company, address and time zone; a sub branch sits in a branch and takes its company.
Departments of each company; a sub department names its parent department in the same company.
Designations with level, grade, department and experience range (low to high).
Skill master, then Designation wise skills
The skill library; then the skills each designation needs with the level expected, published as a new dated version.
Places used in addresses and statutory settings: a district names its state, a city its state and district.
Your own organisation dimension and its values (its name is set in Setup › Core HR).
Customers that projects are run for; then projects with customer, dates, manager and members (current or joining staff only).
Integration uploads: the accounting codes of the masters you have just loaded.
procedures.result: Every master exists before a file that refers to it, so no row fails on an unknown code. A code already on file is updated; a new code creates a record.

procedures.title: Workforce uploads: what each one loads

steps: Salary bank accounts: add where none is on file, update the salary account, or both. Listed only to its uploader.
Children of employees; relation defaults to child, read as son or daughter by gender.
Contract staff terms: the agency (an active vendor), the contract number and its dates.
Family members who depend on the employee; Dependent defaults to yes.
Qualifications: degree, institute, year and score, matched to your qualification masters by name.
Dated job changes: company, branch, department, designation, grade, manager and more; one change per row, in date order.
Old code to new code. A code another employee holds is refused; with no device user id, the old code becomes it.
Values of your own employee fields: employee code, field key or label, value.
Attendance device id, work schedule, pay mode and paying account, birthday sharing and sign-in time zone.
Skills each employee has, with level on your profile scale.
Parents and spouse: name, date of birth, gender, occupation, dependant and nominee details.
Health insurance policies and the members insured.
Nominees per benefit (PF, gratuity, insurance …) with shares totalling 100%; the file's set replaces the set on file.
Income and tax from a previous employer this financial year; replaces the previous employer on the declaration.
Pins page shortcuts to employees' favourites; Remove = yes unpins.
Business partners: staffing agencies, contractors and other vendors, by vendor code, with PAN and GST checks.
Earlier jobs: employer, designation and dates. Refused for a fresher.
New hire, New hires (advance), Employee, Personal details
Add new employees (essentials or every field) and update employee or personal details. Shown only once PeopleOS switches on bulk employee import.

procedures.title: Time Office uploads: what each one loads
procedures.before: Needs employee.import plus attendance.override (status, hours, paid days, monthly sheet), attendance.manage, attendance.roster, attendance.punch, attendance.arrears, leave.adjust or leave.manage as named.
steps: Punches from devices or other systems. Adds only; a punch already loaded is skipped. Needs attendance.punch.
The status of a day, or of each half, with a reason.
Comp-off credits for days worked, with expiry, credited as approved comp-off claims. A day already claimed is skipped.
Places employees may check in from.
Adds or takes away leave days as an adjustment.
Leave already taken or approved (history). Needs leave.manage.
One sheet per month: a row per employee, a column per day. Choose the month and how blank days are read.
Leave balances at the start of the year; an opening balance cannot be negative.
HR's arrear days of an earlier month to pay or recover in the next run; replaces that month's calculated arrears.
Sets or reduces a month's paid days, only while Setup › Time office › HR may adjust paid days is on.
Approved overtime for days of an earlier month; locked days also need corrections after finalisation allowed.
The hours worked on a day, in minutes, with a reason.
Opening balances of the restricted-holiday leave type (RH unless the file names another of that category).
Shift roster: the shift each employee works on each day.
procedures.result: You know which Time Office process to use and which permission it needs.

procedures.title: Payroll uploads (pay, statutory and overrides): what each one loads
procedures.before: Needs employee.import plus payroll.manage; statutory overrides payroll.override; Employee statutory employee.sensitive.update; Settlement exit.settle; CTC uploads compensation.cycles and compensation.propose.
steps: Annual CTC for one company; components come from the salary structure. Prepares a draft compensation cycle.
CTC with the amount of each component; prepares a draft compensation cycle.
Moves employees to another salary structure through a draft compensation cycle.
PF, ESI and PT applicability, PT state, tax regime, PAN, Aadhaar reference, UAN, PF and ESI numbers. LWF follows the establishment.
ESI for a payroll month: employee share, or ESI_ER in Line for the employer's.
Provident fund for a payroll month: employee share, or PF_ER or VPF in Line.
Professional tax to use for a payroll month.
Labour welfare fund to recover in a payroll month, arrears included (LWF_ER for the employer's).
Income tax (TDS) to deduct in a payroll month.
Voluntary PF and PF wage options per employee.
Arrears of earlier months, added as an arrear adjustment in the open pay month.
Variable pay to pay in a payroll month; each request waits for someone else's decision.
Full and final settlement lines for leavers whose settlement is still draft or calculated.
Not available as an upload: bonus rates come only from the verified Payment of Bonus rule.
Not available yet: PF on arrears needs the separate EPFO arrear return, not yet verified in PeopleOS.
procedures.result: You know which pay and statutory data can be loaded, and which comes only from verified rules.

procedures.title: Payroll uploads (tax declarations, loans, reimbursements): what each one loads
procedures.before: Needs employee.import plus payroll.manage.
steps: TDS or TCS deducted or collected elsewhere that the employee declares; counted as tax already deducted. Adds only.
Rent a month, months, landlord, landlord PAN, address, city and metro; replaces the rent on the declaration.
Income paid outside payroll that counts for tax.
Tax-saving declarations (80C, 80D …), one item per row; 0 removes an item. Verified proofs are never changed.
Perquisite value for the year; TDS spreads the tax over the remaining months.
Perquisite value and what the employee pays back; TDS taxes the difference.
Salary paid before PeopleOS this financial year, for tax and year-to-date figures; not for payslips.
Loans and advances raised under the loan policy. Approved rows are approved by you, never your own loan.
Bills behind reimbursements paid with salary every month.
Claims raised for employees with their bills listed; approval stays with someone else.
Unclaimed balances brought forward, once per employee, component and year.

procedures.title: Performance, Engage and Asset uploads: what each one loads
procedures.before: Needs employee.import plus performance.manage (Initiatives performance.initiatives_manage, PIP performance.pip, normalisation performance.calibrate), recognition.manage, recognition.points, engagement.events or asset.manage.
steps: Ready-made goals people pick from: the KRA library with suggested KPIs, by code.
Employees' goals with weight and target, checked against the goal sheet policy and weight limits.
Normalised final ratings of a cycle, as calibration adjustments with a reason. Updates only.
Normalised ratings of a periodic review, with a reason.
Final achieved value of each key result, recorded as a check-in.
HR's total achievement of each objective, only while goal achievement override is on in Setup › Performance.
Plans with dates, reviewer, objectives and checkpoints, opened as drafts; Start now = yes starts them through the PIP policy.
Ratings given in the periodic reviews of a cycle.
Badges HR allocates for the organisation; receiver rules and limits apply, not your own quota.
Reward points credited from the budget or debited from earned points, with a reason.
Asset types (categories) and the sub types inside each, by code.
Products (make and model) of each asset type.
The asset register: tag, product, serial number and purchase details. Status and custodian of a tag on file never change from a file.
procedures.result: You know which talent, engagement and asset data can be loaded in bulk.

procedures.title: Integration uploads: load accounting (JV) codes
procedures.before: The masters exist. You hold employee.import and integration.manage.
steps: JV company, JV branch, JV sub branch mapping
Accounting codes of companies, branches and sub branches.
JV business unit, JV department, JV sub department mapping
Accounting codes of business units, departments and sub departments.
JV designation, grade, level, region, dimension, employee mapping
Accounting codes of designations, grades, levels, regions, your dimension values and employees.
JV pay component and pay component payable mapping
Ledger codes of earnings, deductions and employer contributions, and their payable ledgers, for the payroll journal voucher.
Code (of the record), JV code, and Accounting system code (blank: the code applies to every accounting system).

procedures.title: Require a second person to approve uploads (maker-checker)
procedures.before: Decide which upload types need a second person, for example bank details, salary and loan uploads.
steps: Setup › Governance, group Data import: Who approves an upload = Another person (maker-checker), or A workflow.
Upload types this applies to (blank = every type); Only holders of this role approve uploads (blank = anyone allowed).

procedures.title: Check a change and verify the audit chain
procedures.before: You hold audit.view; Verify integrity also needs audit.verify.
steps: Insights › Audit › Change history. The newest events are first.
Search the record name, or filter Action, Module and From / Until.
Choose View. Read What happened and Field changes (each value before and after).
Unfold Who and where: actor, roles, source, IP address, browser and request id.
Back on the list choose Verify integrity. Expect Chain intact: N events verified.
procedures.result: You can show exactly who changed what and when, and that no event has been altered since it was written.

procedures.title: Trace everything one upload or one employee's record went through
procedures.before: You hold audit.view.
steps: Insights › Audit › Change intelligence. Unfold the filters above the table.
Pick the Employee by code, add From and To, and apply the filters.
Filter Action = Bulk Operation, show the Operation column, copy the id of the row naming your file.
Paste it in Operation id: the list shows only the changes that run made.
Choose Explain: what, who, when, why, the approval or workflow run, the integration, each field before → after.
procedures.result: You can answer what changed, who did it, why, and through which approval, upload or integration.

procedures.title: Review how the AI assistants are used

steps: Insights › Audit › AI interactions. The newest conversations are first.
Filter Assistant, or Feedback = Not helpful to find answers people questioned.
Choose Read: the question, the answer, the sources it used and any links it proposed.
Not sent means nothing left PeopleOS; Sent shows the policy and how many values were redacted or removed.
Setup › Governance: Data the assistant may send to an external AI provider: None, Allowed data or Restricted data too.
procedures.result: You know what the assistants answer, whether answers help, and that data leaves PeopleOS only under your policy.

warnings.title: Nothing is written until you run the file

A finished import cannot be discarded or undone from the upload; correct records with a new upload or on their screens.

warnings.headline: Running a file with errors loads only the good rows.

Re-upload fixes discards this upload and returns you to step 3.

Employee statutory does not take LWF: LWF follows the establishment's statutory profile.
warnings.todo: Ask PeopleOS support if you need bulk employee import switched on.

warnings.title: Some uploads need a setting switched on first

warnings.body: These uploads follow the same rules as their screens.

Override previous month overtime on locked days: Setup › Time office › Allow corrections after payroll is finalised.

warnings.title: Pay uploads prepare cycles; they do not pay
warnings.headline: CTC, Salary structure and Change pay group create draft compensation cycles.
warnings.body: Nobody's pay changes until each cycle is submitted, reviewed, approved and executed by different people. These uploads are listed only to their uploader (and the checker).
points: Open the cycle from the upload to submit it for review.
Another administrator cannot open your salary upload.
warnings.todo: After the run, open the compensation cycle and send it for review.

warnings.title: By default the uploader approves their own file
warnings.headline: Who approves an upload starts as The person working on it.
warnings.body: For sensitive data (bank details, salaries, loans, statutory numbers) a second pair of eyes prevents costly mistakes.
points: Another person (maker-checker): the uploader cannot approve.
A workflow: build a workflow on Data upload validated; while none is running, another person approves.
warnings.todo: Set the rule in Setup › Governance (group Data import).

warnings.title: The audit trail cannot be changed
warnings.headline: No one can edit or delete an audit event from the application.
warnings.body: Each event is chained to the one before it by a hash, so any alteration would break the chain. To correct a mistake, make a new change with a reason; both stay on record.
points: PeopleOS also verifies every organisation's chain each night.
Give reasons a reader will understand later.

warnings.title: If Verify integrity says Chain broken
warnings.headline: Treat a broken chain as a security incident.
warnings.body: The message names the first event that does not match and why. Do not try to repair data yourself.
points: Note the event id and reason shown.
Note the time you ran the check.
warnings.todo: Contact PeopleOS support at once with the event id and reason.

warnings.title: Masked values stay masked
warnings.headline: •••• in the trail is by design.
warnings.body: Sensitive fields (bank account number, PAN, Aadhaar reference, UAN, PF and ESI numbers, salary, CTC) are masked when the event is written and cannot be revealed later.
points: In Change intelligence, values on bank, statutory, pay and confidential records are also masked unless you hold employee.sensitive.view.

warnings.title: Give ai.admin sparingly
warnings.headline: Questions to the assistants can carry personal context.
warnings.body: That is why audit.view alone does not open AI interactions. Give ai.admin only to people who govern AI use.
points: Each person can still see their own conversations.
Prohibited data (passwords, keys, tokens) is never sent outside or stored in the log.

checklist: Before every upload
Download the sample file of the exact process and keep its header row.
File format
CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited), up to 10 MB; dates as YYYY-MM-DD or DD-MM-YYYY.
Codes
Company, branch, department, leave type and pay item codes exist and match your masters.
Intent
Insert, update or both chosen on purpose; rows outside it are skipped.
Review
No rows With errors, or each error understood; no rows left To decide.
Reason
A reason someone will understand in a year, e.g. Opening leave balances from the old system.
After the run
Status Imported in Recent uploads; Download results kept; a few records spot-checked.
Approval rule
Maker-checker set in Setup › Governance for bank, salary and other sensitive uploads.
Monthly
Run Verify integrity; review Role Changed, Permission Changed and Setting Changed events.
Quarterly
Review AI interactions marked Not helpful; confirm the AI data policy and retention period.
